tagline: Regional bank managing capital and risk across diverse client segments
hero_kpi_rationale: Significant growth in book value per share (+14% YoY), reflecting improved capital and financial performance, a key metric for regional banks.

kpis.name: Book Value per Share
kpis.explanation: Shareholder equity divided by common shares outstanding

kpis.name: Tangible Book Value per Share
kpis.explanation: Book value excluding goodwill and intangible assets per share
kpis.description: Tangible book value per common share, excluding goodwill

kpis.name: Equity-to-Assets Ratio
kpis.explanation: Total equity divided by total assets, expressed as percentage
kpis.description: Ratio of equity to total assets, a measure of financial strength

kpis.name: Tangible Equity to Tangible Assets Ratio
kpis.explanation: Tangible equity divided by tangible assets, expressed as percentage
kpis.description: Ratio of tangible equity to tangible assets, excluding goodwill

kpis.name: Tier 1 Risk-based Capital Ratio
kpis.explanation: Tier 1 capital divided by risk-weighted assets
kpis.description: Tier 1 capital ratio based on risk-weighted assets
kpis.signal: Regulatory ratio well above required minimums

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: CET1 capital divided by risk-weighted assets
kpis.description: Common Equity Tier 1 ratio based on risk-weighted assets

kpis.name: Total Risk-based Capital Ratio
kpis.explanation: Total capital divided by risk-weighted assets
kpis.description: Total regulatory capital ratio based on risk-weighted assets

kpis.name: Leverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Tier 1 capital divided by adjusted average total assets
kpis.description: Regulatory leverage ratio (Tier 1 capital to adjusted average assets)

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and data breaches
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K with strong language on persistent and sophisticated threats. The risk is repeated across multiple sections including governance and incident management. Increased vigilance compared to prior year with regular exercises. Highly critical category for a financial institution.

risks.title: Non-compliance with cybersecurity regulations
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions compliance with GLBA and mandatory regulatory examinations. Language indicates growing pressure from regulators. Risk amplified by the highly regulated nature of the banking sector.

risks.title: Failure in third-party vendor controls
risks.score_rationale: Risk is detailed within third-party management, including due diligence and periodic reviews. Language intensity highlights increasing exposure through service providers. Cybersecurity category reinforces severity.

risks.title: Internal security controls failure
risks.score_rationale: Security program relies on three lines of defense. Internal audits identify gaps addressed under supervision. System is robust but operational dependency is total.

risks.title: Business disruption following a major incident
risks.score_rationale: Disaster recovery plan is described in detail with dedicated crisis teams. Risk is considered critical but mitigated through regular testing. Strategic placement within governance.

risks.title: Inadequate management of technology innovation risks
risks.score_rationale: Technology Committee oversees strategic investments, but risk related to adoption of emerging technologies is implied. Language is cautious but not alarming. Less critical than other cybersecurity risks.

ai_positioning.summary: KeyCorp does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
